title: No accidental composition in God
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): THUS FAR we have seen that no substantial composition upon God falls. Concerning ye accidental there follows. God mutable is not, as below will be proved. Integral He is not, because God properly quantified plus extended is not. Whatever accidental in creatures is, in God ye substance itself is.
pass_b_english: THUS FAR we have seen that no substantial composition falls upon God. There follows concerning the accidental. God is not mutable, as will be proved below. He is not integral, because God properly is not quantified and extended. Whatever is accidental in creatures is in God the substance itself.
source_text: HACTENUS vidimus in Deum non cadere ullam compositionem substantialem. Sequitur de accidentali. Deus non est mutabilis, ut inferius probabitur. Integralis non est, quia Deus proprie non est quantus & extensus. Quicquid accidentale in creaturis est, in Deo est substantia ipsa.
